name: what-a-pull
description: An open-source knowledge feed that turns the feed into a personal knowledge system.

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.db:test: psql "${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:54322/postgres}" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f scripts/smoke-read-path.sql -f supabase/tests/delta_negation.sql -f supabase/tests/search.sql -f supabase/tests/catalogue.sql -f supabase/tests/identity_privacy.sql -f supabase/tests/anon_write_bounds.sql -f supabase/tests/account_security.sql -f supabase/tests/guest_bounds.sql -f supabase/tests/step_outputs.sql -f supabase/tests/graph_dispatch.sql
